def png_write(path,img):
    H=len(img); W=len(img[0])
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+bytes(row) for row in img)
    def chunk(t,d):
        return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
